verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs say Obsidian Sync supports collaborating on a shared vault with a team, and Sync's version history lets users view or restore earlier versions of a note. That covers the sharing half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows how simultaneous edits are merged or how conflicts are prevented, so the 'without stepping on each other's changes' half is unproven. missing for 10: documented concurrent-edit conflict resolution or real-time co-editing, collaborator permissions or access controls, independent hands-on corroboration of shared-vault collaboration.
